fuente.titulo: Vatican presents Pope Leo's Apostolic Journey to Latin America

titular: Vatican briefs press on Pope's Latin America trip
bajada: Leo XIV will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he once served as missionary and bishop
caption: The Holy See Press Office held a briefing on Tuesday, November 3, detailing Pope Leo XIV's upcoming Apostolic Journey to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru — countries closely tied to his years of missionary and episcopal service. Source: Vatican News, Nov 3, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A press briefing room at the Holy See with a large map of South America on a screen; a Vatican spokesperson stands at a podium in the upper right third, left and center space open.
